subject.title: feat(cron): event triggers — polled condition-watcher scripts via code mode

question: Should OpenClaw accept cron condition-watcher scripts as a core, default-off cron/code-mode feature via the linked PR?
rationale: The request is a new core cron, config, storage, gateway protocol, CLI, and code-mode capability with security implications, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not decide product acceptance.

options.title: Review and sponsor the linked PR
options.body: Proceed with maintainer review of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101195 as the candidate implementation and close this issue only after it lands or is rejected.

options.title: Narrow the design first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers split the security/config/code-mode contract into a smaller approved design before implementation proceeds.

options.title: Defer or reject core support
options.body: Close the paired work only if maintainers decide condition watching should live in an external plugin/hook workflow instead of core cron.

recommendation.title: Review and sponsor the linked PR
recommendation.body: Proceed with maintainer review of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101195 as the candidate implementation and close this issue only after it lands or is rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the issue, authored the linked PR, and has the strongest recent cron/code-mode history in this exact proposal.
